title: Russian Lamb Pie
description: A hearty and flavorful pie filled with lamb and spices, inspired by traditional Russian cuisine.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place it in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large skillet, cook the lamb over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the salt, black pepper, and thyme to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the lamb mixture into the pie crust and spread it out evenly.
Cover the pie with another pie crust or a pie crust top and crimp the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before serving.
